svg.text: ALL DIMENSIONS SHALL BE VERIFIED BY XYZ CONTRACTORS BEFORE WORK.
ELEVATION ARE TO CENTER LINES UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED.
ORIENTATION OF ABCD VALVES SHALL BE VERIFIED AND CORRECTED AT SITE.
ALL INSTALLATIONS SHALL BE VERIFIED BEFORE STARTUP OPERATIONS.
CROSS-CHECKING AT CRITICAL SITES NEAR EFGH VALVES IS COMPULSORY.
FOR MAINTENANCE, ABCD VALVES ARE ACCESSIBLE FOR INSPECTION.
PQR VALVE TO BE INSTALLED AT 0 POINT.
ALL FIXTURES ARE VALIDATED AND COMPLIANT WITH XYZ.
FOR GENERAL NOTES AND LEGENDS SEE THE DWG-1.23.23.456 SERIES.
PLEASE NOTE EVERY DATA PROVIDED HERE IS RANDOMLY GENERATED.
BUILDING TO BE IN THE SLANTING PLANE THROUGH THE AXIS OF PQRS TYPE VALVES.
FOLLOWING XYZ SCHEMES ARE REQUIRED. SEE ABC DWG-1.23.45.67.89.
TEMPERATURE CONTROL IS SET TO ON/OFF TYPE BY DEFAULT.
COMPONENTS ARE AT NORMAL PRESSURE WITH POWER RATINGS 15.4 KWh.
